title: Abanyakuri bo muri Makka
intro: Mu minsi ya mbere y’ihishurirwa, ubwo ubutumwa bw’ukuri bwahuraga n’ibitotezo bikomeye, hari abantu bamwe bahagaze badashidikanya mu kwemera kwabo. Aba bizera bahuye n’ubugome budasanzwe buturutse ku bashakaga kuzimya urumuri rw’ukwemera. Imibabaro yabo yari ikomeye, imibabaro yabo yari myinshi cyane—nyamara indimi zabo ntizahwemye kwamamaza Ubumwe bwa Allah. Nubwo bajugunywe mu bwigunge, uburinzi bw’Imana bwarabakikije, buhindura ikigeragezo cyabo ikimenyetso cy’ukwemera cy’iteka ryose. Reka dusuzume urugendo rw’abo bantu batangaje.
clues: Twageragejwe n'ibihano bikomeye kubera kwanga kureka kwizera Imana Imwe
Abantu bacu ntibashoboraga gusenya icyemezo cyacu, uko ubugome bwabo bwaba bumeze kose
Twari twamanitswe ku iriba ku manywa, ariko ubufasha bw'Imana bwahoraga buri hafi yacu
Ugukomera kwacu kwatangaje ndetse n'ababonye kwihangana kwacu
Benshi muri Makka bashatse kuduhatira kwisubiraho, ariko twakomeje gushikama
Ubwo byose byasaga nkaho byazimiye, umudendezo wacu waje binyuze mu buryo bw'igitangaza bw'Imana
